instructions_to_main_agent: Build a hybrid_fullstack React Native Expo application using NativeWind/Tailwind for styling.
Feature Parity: Browse, search, cart, checkout, orders history, user profile.
Auth Flow: Implement Username/password login for existing users, and OTP (SMS) registration flow for new users.

Localization: Implement multi-currency (Lekë 'L' and Euro '€') and multi-language support (English, Hindi, Albanian/Shqip, Italian, Greek, French, Macedonian). Add a switcher in the Profile tab and Splash/Onboarding screen.
Checkout & Cart: 'Cash on Delivery' is the ONLY allowed checkout method. Implement delivery fee logic: Free delivery on orders over 1500 L.
UI Chrome: Use '@expo/vector-icons' or 'lucide-react-native' for icons, but you MUST use standard text Emojis for category cards as per the brand website.
Navigation: Implement Bottom Tab Navigation (Home, Categories, Cart, Orders, Profile).
Testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
